hypothesis: Request258 has positive development economics, while Request259 fails because sparse historical one-second aggregates rarely support a 5-second execution reference. A causal execution-support classifier using only pre-decision minute/path and completed-second activity can filter Request258 entries without destroying its economic edge.
population: Request258 top-20% train / top-5% development-test candidate stack

execution_label.immediate: one-second aggregate open exists after state+1s within 5s
execution_label.continuation: at least 3 of the next 5 clock-minute anchors have a one-second aggregate open after anchor+1s within 5s

policy: At each >=2% pullback state, ENTER only if all frozen Request258 economic conditions pass and execution-support probability >=0.60; otherwise WAIT and reconsider later. Window exhaustion means cash.
forbidden: changing Request258 economic model or thresholds
using future seconds as execution features
treating missing aggregate bars as proof of market fill impossibility
next_if_pass: Freeze the economic+execution-aware controller and preregister June15-19 validation.
next_if_fail: Historical one-second aggregate support remains too sparse; preserve Request258 economic evidence and separate live quote/broker execution validation from historical aggregate backtesting.
